content: Stremio addon protocol: HTTP manifest.json + resource endpoints (catalog/meta/stream/subtitles). Catalogs return stripped meta-preview lists for Discover rails; clicking an item loads full meta (synopsis, cast, seasons/episodes for series); selecting a video triggers stream addon queries (torrent/debrid links) and subtitle addon queries in parallel. This confirms a clean separation: catalog metadata vs. playback-source resolution vs. subtitles, each independently pluggable.
